textTemplates.name: Application_Approved_COE_Body
textTemplates.text:
Dear {!Get_COE_Contact.Name},

We are pleased to inform you that the application titled “{!$Record.Project_Title__c}” submitted by {!Get_COE_Contact.Account.BillingCity} WIN-COE has been approved by the [Approving Committee/Agency Name] as of {!$Record.Approved_by_COE_on__c}.

Please review the approval letter/document attached for next steps and compliance requirements. Our team will connect with you shortly to coordinate implementation and reporting procedures.

Congratulations to the entire COE team on this successful milestone.

Sincerely,

Wadhwani Foundation

textTemplates.name: Application_Approved_PI_Body
textTemplates.text:
Dear [Dr./Prof.] {!$Record.PI_Name__c},

We are pleased to inform you that the application titled “{!$Record.Project_Title__c}” has been approved by the {!Get_COE_Contact.Name} as of {!$Record.Approved_by_COE_on__c}.

You may now proceed with the next steps as outlined in the approval letter/document attached.

Congratulations on this successful outcome, and thank you for your continued dedication to research excellence.

Sincerely,

Wadhwani Foundation

textTemplates.name: Application_Rejected_COE_Body
textTemplates.text:
Dear {!Get_COE_Contact.Name},

After careful review of the proposal and the presentation before the Selection Committee, we would like to inform you that the application titled “{!$Record.Project_Title__c}” submitted by the {!Get_COE_Contact.Name} WIN-COE has not been selected for funding support by the {!Get_Account.Name} in this round following their review on {!$Record.Rejected_by_COE_on__c}.

The review panel’s comments and feedback have been attached for your reference. You are encouraged to consider these recommendations should you wish to revise and resubmit the proposal in future rounds of calls for applications.

Please don’t hesitate to reach out to [Name] on [Email ID] if you would like to discuss the feedback or next steps.

Sincerely,

Wadhwani Foundation

textTemplates.name: Application_Rejected_PI_Body
textTemplates.text:
Dear [Dr./Prof.] {!$Record.PI_Name__c},

We thank you for the submission of application titled {!$Record.Project_Title__c} to us. After careful review of the proposal and the presentation before the Selection Committee, we would like to inform you that the your application titled “{!$Record.Project_Title__c}” has not been selected for funding support by the {!$Record.Account.Name} in this round following their review on {!$Record.Rejected_by_COE_on__c}. 

The review panel’s comments and feedback have been attached for your reference. You are encouraged to consider these recommendations should you wish to revise and resubmit the proposal in future rounds of calls for applications.

Please don’t hesitate to reach out to [Name] on [Email ID] if you would like to discuss the feedback or next steps.

Sincerely,

Wadhwani Foundation

textTemplates.name: Application_Rejected_Subject
textTemplates.text: Application Status Update

textTemplates.name: Application_Resubmission_COE_Body
textTemplates.text:
Dear {!Get_COE_Contact.Name},

Following the review of the application titled “{!$Record.Project_Title__c}”, the {!$Record.Account.Name} has requested resubmission with revisions from the [Location] WIN-COE.

The review feedback outlining the required modifications is attached. Please ensure the revised application is prepared and submitted by {!$Record.Due_Date_for_Resubmission__c}.

Should you require any assistance during the resubmission process, please don’t hesitate to reach out to [Name] on [Email ID] anytime.

Thank you for your cooperation and commitment to continuous improvement.

Sincerely,

Wadhwani Foundation

textTemplates.name: Application_Resubmission_PI_Body
textTemplates.text:
Dear [Dr./Prof.] {!$Record.PI_Name__c},

Following the review of your application titled “{!$Record.Project_Title__c}”, the {!$Record.Account.Name} has requested resubmission with revisions. The feedback outlining the areas that need to be addressed is attached.

Please review the comments carefully and prepare the revised submission latest by {!$Record.Due_Date_for_Resubmission__c}.

Please don’t hesitate to reach out to [Name] on [Email ID] to assist with any questions or clarifications during the resubmission process.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Sincerely,

Wadhwani Foundation

textTemplates.name: Application_Resubmission_Subject
textTemplates.text: Application Requires Resubmission

textTemplates.name: Application_Submitted_Body
textTemplates.text:
Dear [Dr./Prof.] {!$Record.PI_Name__c},

This is to inform you that the application titled “{!$Record.Project_Title__c}” has been successfully submitted to the {!Get_COE_Contact.Name} on {!$Record.AppliedDate}.

Should any additional documents or clarifications be required, you will be notified promptly.

Sincerely,

Wadhwani Foundation

textTemplates.name: Application_Submitted_Coe_Body
textTemplates.text:
Dear {!Get_COE_Contact.Name},

This is to inform you that the application titled “{!$Record.Project_Title__c}” from the {!$Record.Account.BillingCity} WIN-COE has been successfully submitted to the {!$Record.Account.Name} on {!$Record.AppliedDate}.

Please ensure all supporting documents and institutional endorsements have been uploaded as required. Should any additional details be needed, our team will reach out accordingly.

We appreciate your prompt coordination and continued engagement in driving impactful initiatives.

Sincerely,

Wadhwani Foundation
